notes: Tesla battery in the header, read from TeslaMate on the dashboard host (dimmed with its age while the car sleeps). Sensor history no longer records zeros for unreachable devices, so outages read as gaps instead of flat lines. Sparklines fetch 24h instead of the whole 7-day dump (86% less traffic). Yeelight polling backed off to stay clear of the bulbs' command quota. The header's inside temperature ignores dead thermostats.
